samples.summary: Third test ("refuses a replace forced past the hidden row") is vacuous — it never invokes a replace path
samples.evidence: The test renders with readOnly, types a query, and then asserts `doc.deleteText`/`doc.insertText` were not called (lines 100-106). Nothing in the test ever attempts a replace: the replace input and buttons are not rendered in read-only mode, and the test's own comment concedes "the input is not even rendered". The assertions therefore hold for any implementation — even one where `handleReplace`/`handleReplaceAll` had no `readOnly ||` guard at all. So the handler-level guards added by this diff (docs-find-bar.tsx:132 and :143), the second half of the claimed defence-in-depth ("both replace handlers refuse, so neither the buttons nor the Enter key in the replace input can reach a CRDT write"), have zero coverage: deleting `readOnly ||` from both handlers leaves this suite green. To actually pin them the test would need to reach the handler (e.g. render non-readOnly, type query+replacement, then rerender with readOnly=true and fire the button/Enter, or exercise `handleReplaceKeyDown` on a rendered input).

samples.summary: New `editor.clearImageSelection()` in `store.onRemoteChange` has no test anywhere
samples.evidence: The delta adds an unconditional image-selection clear on every remote change (docs-view.tsx, inside `store.onRemoteChange`). I grepped `onRemoteChange` and `clearImageSelection` across the repo: the only test files hit are packages/frontend/tests/app/docs/* (none render DocsView or drive onRemoteChange — the doc-store tests cover the store, not this callback) and packages/docs/test/view/copy-integrity.test.ts, which simulates the remote path manually (`store.setDocument` + `doc.refresh()`) and explicitly does NOT call clearImageSelection. So neither the fact that the clear happens on a remote edit, nor its ordering before `refresh()`/`restoreLocalCursor`, nor its no-op-when-nothing-selected property is asserted; removing the line would keep every suite green while restoring the stale-coordinate wrong-image bug it exists to prevent.

samples.summary: Existing copy-integrity tests now model a production path this delta removed; their stated rationale is false
samples.evidence: Three tests (lines 558-586, 588-609, 627-655) justify themselves with comments such as "production drives this from `docs-view.tsx`'s `store.onRemoteChange`, which calls `editor.getDoc().refresh()` and leaves the image selection untouched" and "Drive the remote path production uses ... which leaves the image selection alone". After this delta `onRemoteChange` calls `editor.clearImageSelection()` first, so a stale image selection surviving a remote refresh is no longer reachable in production. The assertions still exercise defence-in-depth guards and are not vacuous, but the delta invalidates their documented scenario, so the suite now claims coverage of a production path that no longer exists while the path that replaced it (finding above) is untested. Comments should be updated to say these are pure defence-in-depth.

samples.summary: Only `handleReplace` is exercised in the writable case; `handleReplaceAll`, the Enter-key path, and the image-selection clear are unasserted

verdict.reason: The third test (docs-find-bar-read-only.test.tsx:96-107) is vacuous exactly as described: it renders with readOnly, changes only the "Find" input, and asserts doc.deleteText/doc.insertText were not called. With readOnly true, docs-find-bar.tsx:288 (`showReplace && !readOnly`) prevents the replace input and both buttons from rendering, and handleReplace/handleReplaceAll are only reachable via those nodes (onClick at :302/:309 and onKeyDown at :297 -> handleReplaceKeyDown :172-180). So no replace path is ever entered and the assertions hold for any implementation — removing `readOnly ||` from :134 and :143 would leave the suite green. No other test covers those handler guards: DocsFindBar appears in no other test file, and packages/docs/test/view/find-replace.test.ts / copy-integrity.test.ts exercise the FindReplaceState model with no notion of the component's readOnly prop. Under the test-adequacy rubric this is a vacuous test presented as coverage for a guard added by this diff protecting against viewer-initiated CRDT writes — major.
